title: Brand title
caption: The brand-title recipe: a full-bleed brand gradient with the logo and one centred headline in the brand font, and no review labels. Made for muted loops such as website hero videos.
prompt: Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 5-second 16:9 muted title card for the Magnifito website hero, in the brand-title style: our logo (assets/magnifito-logo.svg) over the tagline "Digital marketing with heart and value" on the brand gradient. Brand: warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), dark ink #2b1c17, Geist from fonts/. Render it with HyperFrames.
